messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find the dataset titled International Social Survey Programme: National Identity III - ISSP 2013 (Netherlands)?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: International Social Survey Programme National Identity III ISSP 2013 Netherlands dataset DOI
action.query: International Social Survey Programme National Identity III ISSP 2013 Netherlands dataset DOI

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"International Social Survey Programme: National Identity III - ISSP 2013 (Netherlands)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12921","justification":"Exact match for the requested dataset. Archived by GESIS Data Archive in Cologne, Germany, under study number ZA5517 (Version 1.0.0). Authored by Harry Ganzeboom of Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam and published in 2017. The dataset contains survey responses from 1,638 participants in the Netherlands, collected between April and September 2014. It includes 130 variables addressing national identity, national pride, immigration, cultural identity, and attitudes toward international organizations.
